h:
我衷心感谢您对这个工作流程的兴趣。

因为Flux 工作流程 - 具有 Kontext 的多字符

收到了良好的反响，所以我制作了另一个具有类似结果的版本，但使用常规的 Flux-dev 架构（使用 Flux-Redux）运行。

它比使用 Flux-dev-kontext 稍微复杂一些，但它非常直观，并且很容易与其他 LoRA 实现集成。

大多数细节都在工作流程中进行了解释，因此并不难理解。

o.en:
I would like to thank you from the bottom of my heart for your interest in this workflow.

BecauseFlux Workflow - Multi character with Kontext

Received good response, So I made another version with similar results but running with the regular flux-dev architecture (with flux-redux).

It's a bit more complicated than using flux-dev-kontext but it's pretty visual and easy to integrate with other LoRA implementations.

Most of the details are explained in the workflow so it's not hard to understand.
